title: Diff +/- sign has no space before the code in the pending-approval preview, but a space once committed
observed: Same write's diff content renders two different ways depending on which screen shows it: the pending approval prompt (01-write-prompt-capped.txt) reads '  1 +export const line1 = 1;' (sign glued to the code, no space), while the committed diff block after approval (02-write-applied.txt) reads '   8 + export const line8 = 8;' (sign, then a space, then the code).
expected: One glyph-to-text spacing convention for +/- diff signs across both the pending-approval preview and the committed diff block.
design_ref: internal/tui/permission_render.go:279,282 (KilnRed("-"+h.Old), KilnGreen("+"+h.New) — no space) vs internal/tui/transcript.go:196,200 RenderDiffLines (KilnGreen("+ "), KilnRed("− ") — sign plus space)
